name: Sermon
overview: The Sermon, as exemplified in Matthew 13:1-6, reveals Jesus teaching large crowds by the sea, using parables to communicate spiritual truths. He often positioned Himself where many could hear, such as sitting in a ship while the multitude stood on the shore. His teachings, like the parable of the sower, illustrate the varied responses to the gospel message, emphasizing the need for receptive hearts and deep roots in faith.
